en.title: The Event Horizon Archives
en.premise: Near the event horizon of a black hole, time slows to a crawl, and fragments of information drifting from the past manifest as physical matter. Elias, a record keeper who runs a second-hand bookstore, holds a specialized role: recovering and organizing "book" fragments crystallized by the warping of spacetime. One day, he recovers an anomalous mass of information shrouded in a shadow like a lunar eclipse—a computational record from a lost civilization and the key to averting the heat death of the universe. To retrieve the truth from the sea of information, Elias ventures toward the edge of collapsing spacetime.

zh.title: 事件视界的古书录
zh.premise: 在黑洞的事件视界附近，时间的流动极度迟缓，来自过去的碎片信息会以物理“物质”的形式沉淀。经营着一家旧书店的记录保管员埃利亚斯，从事着一项特殊的工作：回收并整理因时空扭曲而结晶化的“书籍”碎片。某日，他回收了一块披着如月食般阴影的异常信息块，那是失落文明的运算记录，更是避免宇宙热寂的关键。为了从信息的海洋中捞起真相，埃利亚斯踏上了前往崩坏时空尽头的旅程。
